nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Get Unblocked Makeup-Removing Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: The products works for me, love them. Gives good moisture and gentle to your skin.
Clears pores COMPLETLY! Gets all makup off my go to for night time skin care!

I am 66 & in my youth had very oily skin. As I aged my skin became dryer & I wanted a cleanser to help moisturize. This is the best I've found. I use as directed and it removes all makeup perfectly, even my mascara. Has never irritated my skin.

avis.titre: One of my favorite beauty products!
avis.texte: I LOVE to get unblocked with the POREfessional. This is the best makeup remover I have used thus far. It is so smooth and not oily at all. It removes mascara extremely well and foundation. Also minimizes the pores. My face looks crisp after use. Don't discontinue. Love it!

I received this product as a free gift when buying foundation from the same brand. I needed to use additional cleansers to remove the foundation, but this did a nice job with my eye makeup and waterproof mascara. It doesn't irritate my skin and hasn't caused any breakouts. Overall, I'd say I like it, but I don't love it. I normally use a cleansing balm to remove makeup, and I feel like the balm works a lot better for me than this does.

avis.titre: Made my breakouts worse & more frequent
avis.texte: I went to Ulta in person with the intention of trying a certain product, the employee said that this item worked extremely well with the one I went in to buy. I realized that when I started to use this one, my acne was just out of control. I have sensitive skjn and have suffered from acne since I was a kid. As I've aged, my skin is less break out prone although still scarred. I thought I was at a point where maybe I can work on my pores and scars since I was not getting as many breakouts. However, this product gave me severe acne on my cheeks, every morning it seemed that I had more white heads popping out. I was using acne patches like crazy. I stopped using it and it has settled down significantly. I was very disappointed in this product. I tried to have the perspective of it gets worse before it gets better since my skin is sensitive, but it just was not worth what I was going through. I will say that that the product does feel oily but my skin felt light after washing it off.

It's just okay, I bought this to use when I travel to remove my make up. At first impression its a nice cleanser, but I've noticed multiple times the next morning that it didn't fully remove all of my mascara from the previous day. I don't even use waterproof mascara. After massaging this into my lashes and all over my face, I use a makeup eraser cloth in warm water to remove the cleanser, then move onto a water-based cleanser and so on. I'm still using this when traveling but once it's gone, I'll try something else.
Love this stuff. I used to use MAC's cleansor oil, but they discontinued it. This oil is actually better than MAC's. So glad i found it

To say the least blackheads are a thing of the past for me due to this product workings as I age, I started getting these like hard wartts on my face., but since Courtney showed me this I don't have them anymore. Thank God for Courtney for introducing me to this product and how to use it helped this aging beauty with whatever warts was on my face. Ty

avis.titre: Removes even the most stubborn makeup
avis.texte: This makeup remover is fantastic. Just a little bit removes most of my makeup daily. I use it with the Good Cleanup cleanser and my skin looks and feels so soft and clean. I loved this mini so much that i immediately bought a full size.

I got this in a sample size as a free gift with purchase. It works well getting my waterproof Mascara off. I washed my face with my usual products but the next morning, my face was red, itchy, and a little swollen. I'm not sure if the remover and my face products didn't react well together but I do have sensitive skin. I wouldn't recommend.
Absolutely a miracle product. Clears blackheads and removes makeup without irritating my sensitive and dramatic skin

I just used this for the first time in a double cleanse routine im trying. I have the nastiest little black dots on my nose (sebaceous fillaments) & after massaging this on my nose & face for about 10 mins, literally half of them are gone!!! pro tip: put a hot/warm washcloth over your face for a few minutes before to open your pores! :)
Does a wonderful job removing makeup. However, it left me with a painful rash and burning eyelids. I've never experienced anything like it.
I love this makep remover. I've tried many different oils balms and wipes but has worked best. Probably wont buy anything else.

avis.titre: Did the job, but my face hated it
avis.texte: I loved the consistency and ease it had with taking off my makeup. However, im not someone who has "sensitive skin", but this product made my face itchy, red and blotchy. I have to take a Benadryl in order to get some relief. I do have their hydration, toner, and clay mask thay comes with this line and those are all fantastic.
No matter how much I rubbed my eyes, it didnt remove my mascara like I had hoped. Also, it made my eyes burn. The smell is rather strong, it's not a bad smell just fragrant. Would not purchase again.
This product is the best thing ever! It cleared out the pores on my cheeks and nose and OMG my face looks better than ever

For the price, I wanted to love it but unfortunately, I don't. I felt like I had to use too much product to fully remove eye makeup and in my opinion the product is a bit watery. It's an okay cleanser but I'll have to try something different

avis.titre: Best makeup remover ever lasts forever too
avis.texte: Best makeup remover ever lasts forever too- I recommend getting a travel first then going to full if you love it but I do bad anytime there is a discount at Ulta etc I buy it!
I bought the travel bottle first make sure it worked and its amazing-easy fast and always rinses clean

I can't tell you if it minimizes pores because I use it only on days I wear makeup. I can say that I love how it leaves my skin. I do have less blackheads and it really takes off all makeup. My skin looks great after using it and I'm planning on incorporating it perm in my routine.

I only use it to take off my waterproof eye make up, I havent paid attention to the skincare side, although I have been getting more pimples, I never get pimples. It takes off my waterproof brows and mascara very well without any irritation or watery eyes, I get watery clody eyes from every other product.
This is a really good first cleanse, it melts makeup easily and my pores look a lot clearer after using this vs just using my regular face wash

I love this cleanser!! This is better than anything I have tried in the last few years!! I've tried many make up remover products this is just a wonderful product that I could tell immediately after using for the first and second night in a row and I can already see a difference in my skin using this along with the Good Cleanup and the speedy Smooth Mask. I was very happy i tried all three! Highly recommend this!!

Poor performance since it doesn't fully removes face and eye makeup. I wear waterproof mascara and the oil didn't break it down, and even worse, it made my eyelashes to fall. I didn't rub it or was aggressive whatsoever, so I was surprised to see that outcome. The balms from Clinique or The Body Shop are much more gentle and more effective.

avis.titre: This has drastically minimized my pores in one month of use!
avis.texte: I have had huge pores on my nose (like you can see them from outer space) forever. One in particular is my "problem" pore. This at night, then using my CeraVe night cream as usual has been AMAZING. Drastically shrinking pores, and I am a believer. This will be in my bag of tricks from now on.

This has bexomr my favorite makeup remover. It doesn't dehydrate your skin, its not too oily, it smells good, and Im not scared to use it to take off my eye makeup. This has worked better to take off my makeup than other removers. Im still iffy on the price but I do love using this.

avis.titre: A scam of a product line
avis.texte: I am so disappointed in this product and entire line. It does absolutely nothing for you skin, it honestly makes it worse. Customer service refused to accept my return even though Product is almost full. The good reviews are 100% from paid influencers. Don't buy into the hype like I did. Embarrassing
I love this for cleaning my pores. It works wonders. I love it. Use the cleanser after it. It's also wonderful 👍👍❤️❤️❤️
removed makeup really well and did not leave my face feeling dry which is always nice.

avis.titre: Not so easy on the eyes
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product but i was very disappointed and surprised! The fragrance irritates my eyes. Usually products ive tried in the past are more gentle.

I've tried many oil cleansers and this one is definitely worth it.. it removed my mascara waterproof and regular.. its silky smooth and rinses off completely no oily residue... biossance cleansing oil was my #1 favorite but now I'm thinking I like this more! it just works a bit better
Works so well! Leaves your face feeling fresh and super smooth

avis.titre: WANTED TO LOVE THIS SO BAD!!
avis.texte: Unfortrunny, it is just too runny. I have used other oil cleaners and they are very rich and this just was not for me. I do love benefit though!!

First of all I'm confused because when I clicked on write a review, it said there are NO reviews yet, but when I look at the product it says there are 100's of reviews!?!? HOW!? avis.titre: One of the best Make Up Remover

avis.titre: Again, I really wanted to love this…
avis.texte: I received the deluxe trial versions of this new line and have been using the products religiously for a solid week, as Benefit recommended. Like I've said in my other reviews I really wanted to love this but it just wasn't for me. I love how lightweight it is, and it did well for my sensitive skin. Didn't dry out my skin at all which was nice. I would use this as a lightweight face wash maybe? But definitely not as a makeup remover. It was subpar in removing my foundation, and did absolutely nothing to remove the waterproof makeup on my lids, lashes and brows.
I absolutely love this makeup cleansing oil. My skin felt so soft afterwards and it doesn't burn my eyes like others do. I will say sometimes my mascara isn't fully off but it still does the job.

Love this cleaning oil, it gets the job done fast and effectively! I love that I don't have to use too much product for ur work and ur leaves my skin feeling nice and smooth. Would I definitely incorporate into my every day routine!
This does remove makeup well but not eye makeup it takes a lot of product and scrubbing. It also burns my eyes. I would not recommend this.

This POREfessional is a great make up removal. It is oil based too. I like how it glide onto my skin while feeling light like clouds. It smell soo good and I only need 2 pump to get a face of make up off. I like how it just leave my skin feeling moisturized as well.

This entire line of pore items are amazing for my skin and has changed things so much. My pores are so much smaller in my skin is actually less oily then before and it's all due to the closing of my pores in this product absolutely love it!

I was given this product by Benefit Cosmetics in exchange for my honest review of the cleanser. The texture is nice and creamy with a really like fresh scent. And I love the cute bottle, very user friendly as well. Highly recommend!

Recently I was gifted by benefit The POREfessional Get Unblocked Oil Cleanser and be the first to try their newest POREfessional Skincare Collection, launched in mid-February 2023. My dry skin loves this cleansing oil. It melts away all those waterproof makeup, even the sunscreen. I love double cleansing my skin in my routine, and this cleanser works like magic. It cleans effortlessly. Just a gentle rub is all you need. It's very runny, and a little goes a long way. The scent is so fresh and pleasant. I love it! It's suitable for all skin types, especially dry ones like mine.

I use this product to takeoff my make up and it worked really well and took off everything that I had on and I didn't leave any residue and was super easy to clean. I also fit right into my skin care routine, which I really enjoyed.

As someone with oily skin I'm typically not a big fan of cleansing oil but this one works well! I love the smell, it's refreshing and not too heavy. It removes makeup quickly and it's quite easy to rinse off.

avis.titre: Incredible product - not for the sensitive of skin
avis.texte: I am a sensitive skin girly. I loved the pre-cleanse based on the smell and feel of it. And it did exactly what it was supposed to do - remove all the makeup from my face. Much better than wipes! However, I cannot use this product multiple days in a row or my face gets too irritated. :( Complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics

I've used other makeup removers before. All super heavily on the oils, but Benefit's oil-cleanser makeup remover is different. Yes, it has the oils but it's not as oily & it washes right off especially with cleansing. It definitely helped removed my makeup without leaving any leftovers after use. I'm going to enjoy this gifted product! It's going to change my make-up removing game (I hope)!

I have really been enjoying this oil cleanser. It takes away all my make up and doesn't leave my skin feeling too oily or with a weird residues. My only down side is that it has a weird fragrance that's almost chemically that I'm not a big fan of

This cleanser is great at removing all of your makeup, and it is gentle on your skin too! It made my skin feel very clear and it also removed my mascara perfectly. Just amazing. Gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

avis.titre: Not for those with sensitive skin
avis.texte: I received complimentary from Benefit. I wanted to love this makeup remover, I really did. It does the job of removing makeup well but it's so strongly fragranced and my skin had an adverse reaction to it. Every single time I used this oil the next morning my skin was covered in small red bumps. I would avoid this if your skin is sensitive to perfumes in skin care.

This oil is awesome! It gets everything off and out of your pores. It's definitely an oil but it isn't a super thick or heavy oil. It leaves you feeling super clean and refreshed. Leaving your face with soft baby skin. My pores always feel nice and clean and ready for bed

I received this product as a gift complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics and absolutely love it. The scent is mild but citrusy. It quickly removed my makeup, even my mascara which I find is usually harder to take off. It also didn't strip my skin which I love as well, I was super hydrated after using it and it was the perfect step in my double cleansing routine.

Being able to cleanse my face without burning and irritation is going to always impress me. This Cleansing oil isn't super runny and get all over the place when using it, it have a very nice consistency without being thick

complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics This is a really nice lightweight oil that does a great job of removing oils and dirt without stripping the skin. I have used cleansing oils in the past and always have to follow up with a cream cleanser, but didn't have to with this.

Cleansing oil texture is nice, small amount melts away my makeup and debris. It doesn't feel heavy on the skin and not feel dry afterwards. Packaging is super fun, i'm really looking forward good results!

I received this product complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics! I used this to remove my makeup and it did an ok job. It didn't completely remove my eye makeup and it did irritate my eyes a bit while using. It has a subtle tropical scent to it so that may be why.

I was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics the POREfessional Get Unblocked Makeup-Removing oil cleanser. This product works well to get the makeup off of my face. The texture is thin but oily and there is a scent. This is a great product to use if you double cleanse in your routine to make sure your skin is left perfectly clean.

Get unblocked is my favorite pre cleanse to remove your makeup. If you're looking for a good makeup remover, this is the one. I like to use this first to remove my makeup and my skin feels squeaky clean.

complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics. I recently tried The POREfessional Get Unblocked Oil Cleanser, and I have to say, I'm impressed with the results. The formula visibly melts away dirt, oil, and makeup, leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean. What's even better is that it visibly unclogs and clears out my pores, which has been a major issue for me. The silky-smooth formula feels lightweight on my skin, making it easy to massage into my skin without any greasy residue. I also love that it feels nourishing and doesn't strip my skin of its natural oils. Overall, I would highly recommend this oil cleanser to anyone looking for an effective solution to cleanse their skin and unclog their pores. It's definitely become a staple in my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Love this new line, love this cleansing oil!
avis.texte: This new Pore Care line from Benefit is just BOMB! I've been able to try out a few products from their Pore care line and each one has impressed me. The POREfessional Get Unblocked Oil Cleanser is a new staple in my routine. I usually get blackheads no matter what I do, so the fact that this cleansing oil not just cleanses my face of all makeup and impurities, but knowing that it specifically focuses on cleaning out my pores is what makes this product stand out from others. It's very refreshing on the skin and has the most subtle, herbal scent that makes you feel like you're in a spa. It leaves my skin looking healthy, nourished and so much brighter. Love it!

I have genuinely loved using this product! It clears away my makeup, and makes my skin feel like I wiped off a layer of dirt. It makes me feel like I got a better clean and am giving myself a better base for my skin. complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics

This product is amazing! A little goes a long way. I was shocked when I used it, the lipstick and eyeshadow disappeared. It's not like typical oils that smear the color all around the skin. Truly obsessed!

This Cleansing oil removed my makeup and helped my oily skin. I have dry combination skin and this did not cause any reaction. The scent is faint and not overwhelming. This was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

I use this cleanser on days that I apply makeup on my face because after a very long day I'm super blotchy / oily. I use this as a double wash if I can't remove the mascara off from the first wash. Luckily I was gifted with this genie in a bottle.

After using this for about a week I like how my skin feels so clean after! I have oily acne prone skin so finding the right facial cleanser is really important to me. I like using this in addition to using miscellar wipes to really clean my face after a full day.

I am in love with this product, it is too incredible, it removes all makeup without leaving a trace of makeup, I loved it, I highly recommend it, all the people need to try this, is really good!! Love it

This has been a great makeup remover and cleanser so far. I like the texture and it seems to do a great job at taking off all of my makeup at the end of the day. It works very well at cleansing my pores as well. So far it's been great.

This cleansing oil is fantastic (!!) at getting all my makeup and gunk off after a long day. It really grabs even the waterproof eyeliner that other similar cleansers don't get. This one is excellent for a double cleanse routine, especially if you have sensitive skin. Complimentary from Benefit

Such a great cleansing oil!! It removes all my makeup and makes me face feel super clean and clear. I follow it up with my regular face wash and I see a visible difference from just using face wash. Highly recommend.

This product was great. Loved the packaging. Extra thin. It loosens up and takes off all my makeup superb. Did I mention it smells amazing? complimentary from benefit cosmetics.

I don't wear a lot of make up but sometimes do a double cleanse, this one was easy to use and smells nice, not too much. I liked that it wasn't very oily when I applied it and easily washed off Would recommend it!

I've been using this make up removing cleansing oil, complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics for the past week and I love it so far. It makes is it so much easier to remove my waterproof mascara. I only have to cleanse once to get the mascara off.

I love Benefit makeup so I'm super excited for their skincare line. This product cleansed my skin without completely drying it out and making me look dull. I recommend for all the problem skin girlies!

This melted my makeup so fast and easy. I love that this isn't just a makeup remover but it also has skincare included. My skin felt hydrated and skin didn't feel too oily. I love that this is focused on the pores.

When my use makeup wipes i have to wash my face atleast twice just to get the rest of the makeup out of my face and the oily feeling. This products took off all my makeup in one use, the oil is thin so it doesnt feel like its clogging my pores but it removes everything

Takes off my makeup very well. Doesn't leave my skin feeling oily or greasy. Works well with my sensitive skin and doesn't irritate or break me out. Doesn't leave my pores feeling clogged. My pores have never looked better

love it! ive only ever used cleansing oils that come in solid form first then they melt on your palm and apply so this was really neat just two pumps and it feel amazing definitely loved it. Will be purchasing when im done with it.

I loved this cleansing oil!!! It took my makeup off nicely. I do follow up with another cleanser. I like to double cleanse. This worked great and I do recommend!!!

I absolutely love this product so much. It truly does melt the makeup off of my face. I feel like a lot of times with makeup removers when it comes to demo mascara and such it bothers my eyes. This product does not do that.

Gifted by benefit cosmetics. This takes off my makeup so effortlessly! It gently gets all the hard to get makeup off. Ive noticed my face is cleaner and softer feeling with a much smaller pores and blackheads!

This is such a great cleaning oil! I have been using it as the first step of my double cleansing routine and my pores look sooo good. I've been using this makeup remover non stop since I got it. I'm totally in love with it! It takes off my makeup super easy ! You only need to apply a little bit for it to melt away the makeup you have on.
